speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: That is something that is still evolving because the agency is new.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The agency has to decide on its priorities and what the focus will be for the next couple of years.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: It will not be too late to establish the sizing and the type of people we will need when these priorities are firmly established.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: We have started investing in the resources to further the professional development of our existing officers for a start.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: This year, MHA has rolled out a new sponsorship programme for officers to take up more advanced degree and professional certification.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: We must maximise the talent and potential of our officers through continuous learning and upskilling.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: To Mr Christopher de Souza's point on the benefits of consolidating science and technology expertise, setting up HTX will, indeed, mean better career progression for Home Team scientists and engineers.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: A dedicated agency, such as HTX, can offer multiple routes of advancement for STEM talent, whether it is leading research teams, managing projects or leadership positions.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: This is quite clear, compared to if they remain within individual Home Team Departments.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Attractive scholarships will be introduced to groom future STEM leaders.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Mid-career professionals with the right training, skills and aptitude will also be recruited to augment our talent pool.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: There may be some specific areas for which we may not have local expertise and thus may need to source for them internationally.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: But I do not expect this to be very large.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: For young Singaporeans taking up studies in STEM, I think it is a very exciting future for them.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The establishment of HTX will add to the range of meaningful careers that they can take part in in Singapore, so that they can be at the leading edge of developing technology solutions to keep our nation safe.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Members like Mr Christopher de Souza also raised questions on how the new HTX agency will work within the broader science and technology ecosystem.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I think Dr Chia Shi-Lu also raised similar concerns.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Singapore today has a vibrant network of science and technology actors, thanks, in part, to Singapore’s investments in science and technology over the decades.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Not only are there established multinational corporations, we also have many innovative startups.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: HTX intends to fully tap on this rich environment.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Over the years, MHA has built strong collaborative relationships with key industry partners.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Public-private co-creation through innovation trials have led to the development of new capabilities.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The vehicle’s evolution into an essential firefighting platform is the result of the sharing of ideas and experimentation with a local company Hope Technik from the time it was quite a modest startup.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Partnership with the private sector will continue to be a mainstay of MHA’s capability development efforts.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Mr Mohamed Irshad will be glad to know that HTX will also partner other public sector Science and Technology agencies, such as GovTech, DSTA and DSO, to name a few.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: For example, HTX will coordinate and work closely with DSTA.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: This is just the most sensible thing to do.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I would also like to thank Mr Christopher de Souza for his suggestion that HTX share with other agencies as well as private companies.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: HTX will share its expertise and capabilities with agencies which have similar needs to the Home Team.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: As for private companies, where the opportunities present themselves, we will keep an open mind.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The strong interest in HTX shows this House’s support for the Home Team and the hard work they put in to keep Singapore safe and secure.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The creation of HTX as a force multiplier for the Home Team ensures we remain mission-effective in the face of future challenges.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: And I am confident that HTX will deliver on its promise as the multiplier to transform the Home Team through greater use of science and technology.

speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo
text: Will it be amongst the community in the ecosystem or will it be within the Home Team facilities?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: We have found some space to accommodate the new HTX and we will work within our resources for a start because the emphasis really is on building the capabilities.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: We want the officers to have a good environment within which to work.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The location of MHA is good in the sense that where public transportation is concerned, our ability to link up with our partners will be quite convenient.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: Can I ask when we are expecting the 100,000 lamp posts to be smartened up?

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: I know the contract was already awarded last year.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: So, could the Minister share with the House when we are expecting all our lamp posts to be watching us?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The smart lamp post project is actually led by GovTech.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: SPF supports the initiative by providing potential use cases, what can we use the data for.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The sensors will be used by SPF strictly to supplement our efforts in crime deterrence and detection.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: So, I think the Member can be assured that the agencies involved are very mindful that great responsibility is expected in how they carry out their duties with the data collection and storage as well as its use.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: We may get requests from the public for access to this data, say, in the events of incidents taking place.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: What is the Ministry's view on requests from private individuals for access to this data?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: As I explained, HTX itself is very unlikely to collect data.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: So, we will have to look at the nature of the request.      .
